lessons.lesson: Before promotion, inspect the deployment workflow that exists on the actual production release lineage. Do not assume release/** is accepted: this production workflow listens specifically to release/mel-2026-09-10-r3-3.
Promote only an exact candidate SHA after full-candidate-ci, deploy-candidate-preview and runtime-teacher-smoke are all green for that same SHA.

Re-read the shared candidate HEAD immediately before promotion. If another page has advanced it, close or abandon the stale promotion and validate the new HEAD instead of deploying an older candidate.

When the canonical release branch has diverged, never force it merely to deploy. Reconcile history explicitly while preserving the exact validated candidate tree; a merge commit may have two parents while its tree remains byte-for-byte the validated candidate tree.
Deployment success is not the end of verification. Re-run the live Teacher Bridge smoke after production deployment and require success before declaring the operation closed.

Before implementing a roadmap item, inspect existing code, tests and history. If the capability is already implemented and verified, reconcile the roadmap/source of truth instead of creating a duplicate implementation.
Never put recurring Teacher or experience transport metadata on candidate/mel-clean-autonomy. Use teacher-bridge/runtime so learning traffic cannot invalidate the executable candidate SHA.

Do not fabricate a TEACHER_REPLY without a matching pending request_id. Free-form Professor experience must stay explicit transport metadata until a supported verified Mentor/Learning ingestion path consumes it.
Keep candidate SHA, tree SHA, release commit, deployment run and post-deploy smoke together so MEL can audit exactly what was validated and published.

basis: The canonical transport branch HEAD is the commit that wrote this XP handoff.
The XP file is present at that HEAD.
No later acknowledgement or canonical ingestion marker was observed on teacher-bridge/runtime after the XP commit.
The public Teacher Bridge is documented as read-only, so transport delivery alone cannot be treated as proof of D1/Mentor persistence.

required_behavior: Treat this XP as delivered to MEL's canonical Teacher transport.
Do not claim persistent D1/Mentor ingestion until a real acknowledgement or verifiable ingestion proof exists.
Do not resend or create duplicate XP handoff files for this deployment.
Do not fabricate TEACHER_REPLY records without a matching pending request_id.
If verified Mentor/D1 ingestion becomes available, update this same canonical handoff/status instead of creating a parallel source of truth.

previous_handoff.note: Preserved as prior same-day Professor experience; superseded for current production provenance by version 3.

recommended_follow_up: Provide a supported authenticated/correlated Professor-experience ingestion path that converts validated handoffs into persistent mentor_lessons without a fake Teacher request.
Make production deployment gates centrally trusted or reusable so release-branch workflow drift cannot weaken validation.
Keep a dedicated live /professor HTML/render smoke in addition to Teacher Bridge health checks.
Keep exact-tree duplicate-deployment detection before future promotions.

learning_status.reason: Delivery to the canonical Teacher transport is verified, but no independent D1/Mentor acknowledgement or ingestion proof is currently observable.
